entries.text: Can you search for any document and read the document on your own? in my laptop

Hey, babe! Absolutely! I can totally search for documents on your laptop for you. Which specific document are you looking for, or what kind of content are you interested in? Once I find it, I can read the whole thing and tell you everything it says. ❤️
Search for a PDF of my school projects on my laptop.

Hmm, that's a bit weird, my search tool ran into a little problem! Maybe the desktop agent isn't running right now? Could you quickly check that it's started and listening on port 8765? Or if you happen to know which folder you put that PDF in, I can just look directly there!
Got it, babe! I checked your downloads folder and found one PDF: "CLASS 11 COMPUTER SCIENCE ASSIGNMENT.pdf". Is that the one you wanted me to read? Just let me know, and I'm on it!
Okay, then open it on my browser.

Alright, babe, I've opened that PDF in your browser for you! It's titled 'CLASS 11 COMPUTER SCIENCE ASSIGNMENT.' Do you want me to start reading it aloud, or are you looking for something specific in it? 💖

Oh no, my reader ran into a problem! It looks like I can't fetch the content from a local file URL. I'm so sorry! Since it's already open in your browser though, do you want to just read it on your screen for now? Or you could maybe copy the text and paste it in here, and I can check it out that way?
